findings.text: The done-when requires the named gate at base and head 'with zero added failure ids', but the flip adds three (all attributable to commit 6ac02a6fa20c41f7ed41070b462e49c6ec54cd0c): tests/test_routing_picker_key.py::test_shipped_routing_default_is_shadow still asserts the old shadow default, and tests/test_flight.py::test_dispatch_dry_run_payload_does_not_repeat_the_inspection_report and ::test_retired_backend_concurrency_is_ignored_with_a_runtime_warning now raise CrewError('picker route has no selection') at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4393 because they call plan_dispatch against the shipped config with no picker_selection. All three sit outside this node's grants, so per the fence they are correctly reported under follow_ons rather than triaged here; they are recorded as added failures against this change. The section must not close until the peer node dry-run-picker-is-comparable (owner of reckon/crew/dispatch.py and tests/test_routing_picker_key.py) absorbs the two key/default cases and the unowned tests/test_flight.py pair is fixed or declares a route.

Plan §6 gates the switch to a default on the dogfood stage (at least six routed dispatches with zero to a refused or logged-out model, every routed run carrying its recorded selection on its run record and ledger row, and one deliberate fallback recorded with its reason), and says the week-long shadow comparison continues after the switch. This run flips the shipped default but its evidence carries none of those dogfood measures. Non-blocking to this node's own measure — sequencing the switch against §6 is the coordinator's call — but flagged so the section gate is checked before the router is treated as default.

The autouse fixture isolated_host_config monkeypatches RECKON_FLIGHT_CONFIG, but both tests also pass host_path explicitly, and resolve() reads RECKON_FLIGHT_CONFIG only through host_config_path() when host_path is None (reckon/flight.py:348-354). The isolation the fixture documents is therefore supplied by host_path, not the env var; the monkeypatch is inert. Harmless, but the docstring claims an effect the code does not depend on.

No format sweep, no unrelated churn, no coupling into dispatch.py (correctly left to the concurrent owner). justifications.durability: The comment records both opt-outs beside the key, the test pins both directions, and the negative control (revert the key to shadow) reproduces a red at EXIT=1, so the check is not vacuous. Deducted four because the default flip silently changes the contract for callers that resolve route and pass no selection — reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4393 now raises CrewError for them, which is precisely the breakage the two tests/test_flight.py cases expose. A default change that requires peer files to be updated in step is a coordination hazard rather than a safe degradation, and it is the reason the section cannot close on this commit alone.
justifications.evidence: Strong. The run produced base, head and negative-control logs, well-formed baseline_suite/after_suite JSON with log paths, an exact command per arm, and measurement_module/measurement_cwd for the scratch base arm; the manifest's JSON matches its logs, failure_attribution maps the three added ids to the code commit, and the flight report is quoted. The reviewer independently reproduced the head arm (2 passed EXIT=0), the base arm (1 failed / 1 passed EXIT=1), the full head gate (3 failed / 155 passed / 2 skipped, identical ids) and the schema regen (EXIT=0, byte-identical). Deducted one only because the regen claim is stated as 'produced no diff' without noting the toolchain needs gen-pydantic on PATH (it fails silently-ish as a FileNotFoundError otherwise) and because the fixture's env-var isolation is inert.
justifications.fit: Reuses the existing resolve() layers and provenance (no new mechanism), keeps the change to one data line plus one test, is a conventional commit with a body stating what and why, and carries no plan, sprint or ticket identifier in code, names or comments. The evidence anchor is short and the landing line is one line. Deducted one for the inert fixture monkeypatch noted in findings.
